# Troth

> Nobody builds a marriage on purpose. Troth is a private iPhone app for the two of you to keep what matters and build what's next, in your own iCloud, never on our servers. Coming in 2026.

Troth is an iOS app for two married people who want to be intentional about the marriage they're building. Everything you put in Troth lives in the couple's own iCloud and syncs between their two iPhones; Troth runs no servers of its own and cannot read it. With Apple's Advanced Data Protection turned on it is end-to-end encrypted. No AI, no ads. Sealed for two. Plain-English details: https://jointroth.co/privacy/

This site is the waitlist landing page. Access opens to a few couples at a time in 2026.

## What Troth is

- The foundation — your vows, your values, your troth, written by the two of you through short guided exercises inside the app.
- One timeline — messages to each other, pictures, places, letters, milestones, and events, in the order they actually happened, in a room only the two of you can open.
- The view — the timeline laid over the foundation, so the two of you can reflect on the year, plan the next one, check in, and work through a hard season.
- Sealed for two — locked with Face ID, kept in the couple's own iCloud, never on Troth's servers.

## Built by

Clark and Carrie Sell, in partnership with the couples on the waitlist.
